intent.purpose: first frame for a talking-to-camera walking clip that a video model will animate
intent.scene_concept: front-camera selfie video paused on its first frame: a woman walking on a suburban footpath in the early evening, about to speak
must_stay_true: it looks like a paused phone video, not a photo shoot
neutral start: mouth closed, eyes on the lens, hands out of frame
room in the frame for natural walking bob and head movement

subject.description: one woman on an evening walk, filming herself
subject.action: walking toward the camera while holding the phone at arm's length
subject.pose: mid-stride, shoulders slightly rotated with the walking arm swing
subject.expression: relaxed, lips closed, about to talk

identity.skin: medium brown skin, even but real texture, slight shine on the forehead
identity.hair: black box braids tied back with a scrunchie, a few loose baby hairs
identity.face: bare face, natural brows, small gold stud earrings

items: faded navy zip hoodie, half zipped
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: hood bunched at the back of the neck

environment.clutter: wheelie bins out for collection at the kerb

camera.device: iPhone 12 front camera in video mode
camera.position: arm's length, slightly above eye level

composition.framing: head and shoulders with the street receding behind
composition.subject_placement: face centred, slightly low, leaving space above for head bob
composition.headroom: a little sky and power lines

lighting.direction: soft skylight from the front, warm points behind

casts: blue dusk cast on the hoodie

processing.noise_reduction: video noise reduction with slight smearing
processing.compression: visible video compression blocks in the sky gradient

texture.hair: braids with frizz and baby hairs

motion.subject: walking forward at an easy pace
motion.blur: slight softness only; the face stays readable for the video model

anatomy: one head, two shoulders; the selfie arm leaves the frame at lower right; the other arm is out of frame
physics: earphone cable hangs and swings slightly
geometry.reflections: car windows reflect street lights only

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding (car badges, bins); do not invent readable text

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no open mouth or mid-word expression in the first frame
no cinematic grade or shallow depth of field
no text overlays, captions or UI

video_handoff.target_model: Seedance or Kling image-to-video via scripts/fal-video.py (check schema and price first)
video_handoff.planned_motion: she keeps walking toward the camera, starts talking after half a second, small natural head movements, handheld walking bob; one continuous take, no cuts, no zoom
first_frame_rules: neutral start pose with mouth closed
face large, sharp enough and fully lit enough for lip sync
no motion blur that the video model would have to invent detail through
space around the head for movement
no text or UI to keep stable across frames
